messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated for service=inference-api release=inf-api-v2.3.1 env=prod-canary :rocket:
Diego Morales: noticed error spike on canary within ~30s. Grafana alert: \"5xx rate > 2% (1m)\" :rotating_light:
Oncall Bot: P1 incident created INC-2483456789. Paging oncall @Emma Li and @Priya Kapoor.
Emma Li: oncall here — quick status? which region and how much traffic on canary?
Raj Patel: canary group only, eu-west-1, ~10% of traffic. Logs show KMS decrypt errors from inference-worker leading to 500s.
Raj Patel: log excerpt:
```
ERROR 2026-03-15T10:46:12Z auth.go:45 PermissionDenied: KMS Decrypt failed
\tat aws_kms.decrypt (kms_client.go:198)
\tcaused by: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/inference-service-prod is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/xyz-rotated-key
```
Alice Wong: we rotated the key earlier this morning (alias/inf-prod-2026-03-15). The deploy should have called create-grant for the new key — CI logs show createGrant errored with 403.
Diego Morales: confirmed deploy job set KMS_KEY_ARN to arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/xyz-rotated-key. The grant step failed: CI output:
```
# aws kms create-grant --key-id $KMS_KEY_ARN --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/inference-service-prod --operations Decrypt
An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the CreateGrant operation: User is not authorized to perform kms:CreateGrant on resource
```
Priya Kapoor: that would leave the worker role unable to decrypt model keys -> 500s. Two immediate actions: 1) cut canary traffic to 0 (feature flag) 2) rollback canary to previous stable image. We should do both asap.
Emma Li: agreed. Diego, can you flip canary flag and add a note to audit log? I can run rollback once canary traffic is killed.
Diego Morales: flipping flag now via admin API:
```
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" https://flags.redwood.ai/api/flags/inference.canary_traffic -d '{"value":0}'
```
Diego Morales: flag set to 0 — canary receives 0% traffic :white_check_mark:. Routing subsystem notified.
Oncall Bot: Canary traffic disabled by Diego Morales. Notifying deploy and routing teams.
Raj Patel: 5xx rate dropping from ~3.4% -> 0.5% within 1m. Some pending queue backpressure still draining.
Diego Morales: initiating rollback to inf-api v2.3.0 (previous stable). Running kubectl set image and rollout undo on prod deployment.
```
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/inference-api inference-api=redwood/inference-api:v2.3.0
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/inference-api
```
deploy-bot: Rollback started by Diego Morales. Old pods scaling up, canary pods terminating.
SRE Bot: readiness/liveness checks passing on stable pods. No spike on error budget for stable.
Diego Morales: rollback complete, all pods back to v2.3.0 and healthy.
Oncall Bot: Incident INC-2483456789 status: mitigated. Actions: canary disabled + rollback applied. Monitoring 30m window open.
Maria Gonzalez: CS here — any customers hit? we have a ticket from acct-42109 complaining about 502s in eu-west-1 around 10:46 UTC. Need brief for them.
Raj Patel: rough numbers: canary window ~2.5 minutes, ~1.5k failed inference calls total across canary. One customer acct-42109 saw ~180 failed requests. No data exfiltration, only availability hit.
Emma Li: drafting CS note: \"During a canary rollout, a newly rotated KMS key was referenced; the CI deploy job failed to create a required grant for the inference role, causing Decrypt failures and transient 5xxs for canary traffic in eu-west-1. We paused canary traffic and rolled back to the prior release. Impact: temporary availability degradation for a subset of requests; no data exposure.\" Will post to CS channel.
Priya Kapoor: follow-ups and owners: 1) CI: make createGrant step idempotent with retries and meaningful failure diagnostics (owner: Diego). 2) Pre-rollout gating: verify KMS grants exist for the deploy-runner identity before canary (owner: Priya). 3) Canary watchdog: auto-pause canary if KMS decrypt errors >0.5% in first 2m (owner: SRE). I'll file JIRAs.
Diego Morales: root cause: deploy-runner IAM lacked kms:CreateGrant permission on the new key during rotation; create-grant failed and we didn't block the rollout. Need an automation to atomically ensure grants exist when rotating keys.
Raj Patel: uploading logs + artifacts to S3: s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-2483456789/logs.tar.gz
SRE Bot: Created follow-up ticket INC-2483456789-T1: pre-rollout KMS grant check assigned to Priya Kapoor.
Oncall Bot: Handoff scheduled — Emma Li primary for 30m, then handoff to Priya Kapoor. Next oncall at 11:00 UTC.
Emma Li: I'll own the timeline and postmortem. Initial timeline + owners noted. Closing active alerts; keeping incident ticket open for action items. Thanks all. :tada:
Oncall Bot: Incident INC-2483456789 marked mitigated at 2483457389. Postmortem link will be attached when ready."
